newsitem.title: USA: CME March lumber up limit on firmer cash ideas.
newsitem.headline: CME March lumber up limit on firmer cash ideas.

text.p: CME March lumber futures ran up the daily limit of $10.00 per tbf and other months followed on expectations of stronger cash markets, traders said.
March was up limit at $415.80 per tbf and May was up $9.20 at $391.20 with other months up $4.00 to $2.20 per tbf.
The forecast for warmer weather spreading across the eastern part of the country prompted ideas that cash lumber markets would strengthen soon, they said.
